# aalhour

> Personal site of Ahmad Alhour: a public notebook for learning in the open about software systems, databases, programming languages, computer architecture, books, and the occasional reflective detour. Bias toward construction: take ideas apart, build small versions, let details teach what abstractions hide.

## About

- [About Ahmad Alhour]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): background, current focus, contact links
- [All writings]({{ '/writings/' | absolute_url }}): chronological essay index
- [Categories]({{ '/categories/' | absolute_url }}): browse by topic area
- [Tags]({{ '/tags/' | absolute_url }}): browse by tag

## Active series

- [Building BeachDB]({{ '/tags/beachdb/' | absolute_url }}): a toy LSM-based storage engine in Go, built in public to learn database internals end-to-end. Topics include WAL/durability, fsync semantics, memtables and skip lists, SSTables, and crash testing.
